instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `demo.ipc2581` and `project_meta.json` are on the desktop. Export padstack usage and a release manifest. Requirements: - Write `padstack_usage.csv` and `manifest.json`. - The padstack report must include name, hole size, diameter, and count. Use header `name,hole_mil,diameter_mil,count`; `manifest.json` must contain `board`, `release`, and `reports`. [Software] For the steps below, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
